records.description: Izakaya Limited states that the IZAKA-YA wallet service began in December 2023. Current service materials describe a cloud wallet using Fireblocks MPC infrastructure.
records.notes: Month precision follows the operator company profile; no day is inferred.
records.title: IZAKA-YA service launch period

records.description: IZAKA-YA stated that some accounts were temporarily restricted from transfers and withdrawals while transactions suspected of illicit-fund or money-laundering involvement were investigated. The same notice announced mandatory KYC for all users and warned that ordinary transfer/withdrawal processing could take longer during enhanced monitoring.
records.notes: This records a provider/account-access and operating-policy change. The operator explicitly stated that this was not a uniform platform-wide withdrawal halt. Do not infer insolvency, customer loss, Fireblocks compromise, criminal conduct by a specific user, or a self-custody/custody transition.
records.title: IZAKA-YA announced account-level transfer/withdrawal restrictions and mandatory KYC

records.notes: Operator states Izakaya Limited, Hong Kong address, and service start in December 2023.
records.title: 会社概要 | IZAKA-YA

records.notes: Operator describes cloud wallet, Fireblocks MPC-CMP, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, swaps and lending.

records.notes: Vendor customer story corroborates embedded Fireblocks custody/management infrastructure. Vendor marketing is not independent proof of overall wallet safety.

records.notes: First-party notice used only for the existence and stated scope of the account-level transfer/withdrawal restrictions and the mandatory-KYC policy change. It is not independent proof of the operator's stated AML cause for every reported withdrawal problem.
